openwrt_wiki_common.hinweis_v7: Status 2026-02-10: The next OpenWrt release 25.12.0 (currently -rc4) has additional sysupgrade images named *squashfs-sysupgrade-v7.bin that should work with recent MikroTik RouterOS v7 bootloaders (successfully tested on mikrotik_routerboard-mapl-2nd). The images *squashfs-sysupgrade.bin (without -v7) are obviously for MikroTik RouterOS v6 bootloaders.
openwrt_wiki_common.warnung_v7: OpenWrt is not compatible with the bootloader of RouterOS v7. Do NOT upgrade the firmware on your device to RouterOS v7 or, if you did, downgrade to RouterOS Firmware v6 before installing OpenWrt. (laut Seite seit 2025-09-12 mit RouterOS 7.19.6 teilweise überholt)
openwrt_wiki_common.tftp_groesse: MikroTik's bootloader (RouterBOOT) may have a size limitation for TFTP images, approximately 7MiB.
openwrt_wiki_common.netboot: RouterBOOT default boot protocol BOOTP; Netboot per Reset-Taster oder serieller Konsole (115200 8N1)

openwrt_git_ath79.titel: ath79: add support for MikroTik RouterBOARD mAP lite
openwrt_git_ath79.Beschreibung: The MikroTik RouterBOARD mAPL-2nd (sold as mAP Lite) is a small 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n PoE-capable AP.
openwrt_git_ath79.LEDs: 4 user-controllable LEDs: 1x power (green), 1x user (green), 1x lan (green), 1x wlan (green)
openwrt_git_ath79.Flashing: TFTP boot initramfs image and then perform sysupgrade. Follow common MikroTik procedure as in https://openwrt.org/toh/mikrotik/common.
openwrt_git_ath79.Netzwerk: The network setup avoids using the integrated switch and connects the single Ethernet port directly. This way, link speed (10/100 Mbps) is properly reported by eth0.

openwrt_dts.leds: power GPIO17 (grün, default on), lan GPIO4, green:user GPIO14 (boot/failsafe/running/upgrade); wlan-LED über wmac led-sources 11

mikrotik_produktseite.Beschreibung: The mAP lite is our smallest wireless access point. It is barely larger than a matchbox, we even had to use a special Ethernet port to match it's slim profile. ... dual chain 802.11 b/g/n device and operates in 2GHz.

mikrotik_quickguide.Beschreibung: The mAP is a small wireless access point with one ethernet port, the ethernet port supports powering by PoE.
mikrotik_quickguide.Powering: Micro USB power jack accepts 5 V DC, a USB 5 V adapter is included with the product. The Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet 11-57 V DC. The Ethernet port also accepts PoE power from a 802.3af switch over the pins +4,5/-7,8 or +3,6/-1,2.
mikrotik_quickguide.Leistung: Under maximum load, the power consumption of this device is 4 W.
mikrotik_quickguide.Ports: One 10/100 Ethernet port (Auto MDI/X); One Integrated Wireless 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n 2x2 MIMO, Onboard PIF antennas, max gain 2dBi; One microUSB 2.0 port for powering only.
mikrotik_quickguide.Reset: Hold before power on: backup boot loader; release when green LED starts flashing: reset RouterOS configuration; release after LED no longer flashing (~20 seconds): look for Netinstall servers.
mikrotik_quickguide.OS: The device supports RouterOS software version 6.
mikrotik_quickguide.EU-Frequenztabelle: 2412-2472 MHz, Kanäle 1-13, 20 dBm EIRP (5-GHz-Zeilen sind Vorlagentext, Gerät hat kein 5 GHz)

lauf.notiz: Imagename mikrotik-routerboard-map-lite ist Neanderfunk-Alias von mikrotik-routerboard-mapl-2nd (gluon-patches-hardware); Upstream-Gluon kennt das Gerät nicht. Ausgewertet: ToH-Dump + Live-hwdata (2026-03-11), OpenWrt-Wiki common (keine Geräteseite), Commits c59fa94e (ar71xx, ab 18.06.0) und eb38af78 (ath79, ab 22.03.0), DTS, mikrotik.mk; MikroTik Produktseite, Broschüre, Quick Guide 2019, Handbuch-Webseite, EU-DoC 2026; FCC TV7MAPL2ND (Übersicht, Handbuch 2015, Label, Innenfotos); WikiDevi/DeviWiki (2 Seiten) + Platinenfotos; Geizhals über Webarchiv; Werkstatt-Doku und RAMpe-Rezept. Widersprüche: PoE-Spannung 10-60 V (Produktseite/Broschüre) vs. passiv 11-57 V (Quick Guide/Handbuch/FCC) vs. 5-60 V (ToH); Leistung 3.5 W vs. 4 W; Antenne 1.5 vs. max 2 dBi; IC-ID 7442A-MAPL2ND vs. TV7MAPL2ND (Handbuch-Webseite); ODM Wistron NeWeb vs. Gemtek. Seriell: 4 unbeschriftete Pads, Pinbelegung offen; ToH 115200 8N1, 3.3 V. Keine Werkstatt-Messung, keine EAN. Abrufdatum tatsächlich 2026-10-20.
